summary: Re-read the County of Grande Prairie page (2026-11-10): every stored value (fees C$29/39 + C$7 fire permit, C$10 online fee, 99 sites, 30 A in loops A/D/E, non-potable taps, dump, showers, online-only booking with a kiosk for drop-ins, season May 15 - Oct 15) still matches what was verified 2026-10-14; nothing to change. Not waterfront and the pin confirmed on imagery.
flags: PHONE: stored 780-532-9727 is the county's Recreation and Culture line on the page; the page also lists 'Park Host Phone: 780-766-2391' (pipestone@countygp.ab.ca), who 'can assist with general inquiries but cannot take reservations by phone or email'. Either is fine; recommend keeping 780-532-9727 (year-round office). Google Maps 4.7 from 14 reviews, no phone shown.
WEBSITE: the county page answered 200 ('Please note that all campgrounds are closed for the season.' - seasonal, no status). CampLife link not re-read.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): the loops sit in forest ~100-150 m from the Wapiti River through a treed bank; the open gravel bar on the river is reached past the day-use field. No change.
PIN (55.04749,-119.09978): at the loop junction near the entrance; the sites are within ~200 m (Google's point 55.04766,-119.09657 is ~200 m east among the loops). No move needed.
